title: Mass cytometry staining for human bone marrow clinical samples
protocol: Fill 15-mL conical tubes with 9 mL of RPMI +10% FBS +1% Antibiotic-Antimycotic and place them at 37°C.
Thaw the bone marrow samples by placing frozen vials directly into a 37°C water bath until content is thawed, approximately 45 seconds.
Transfer the totality of thawed cell suspension into the prepared 15 mL conical tubes containing 9 mL of complete RPMI.
Count cells using AO/PI with the Cellometer Auto 2000 Cell Viability Counter.
Gently invert the conical tubes to ensure accurate cell counts.
Add 20 μL of the AO/PI-diluted sample to a Cellometer SD100 Cell Counting Chamber.
Adjust concentration of cell suspension to 3 × 10^6 cells/sample in complete RPMI.
Centrifuge at 400 g for 10 minutes.
Prepare the 103Rh Viability Stain (1:500 dilution) while the sample is spinning down.
Resuspend the sample in 1 mL of 103Rh Viability Stain.
Incubate for 15 min at room temperature.
Fill conical up to 5 mL with complete RPMI and spin down at 400 g for 10 min.
Carefully aspirate and discard supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.
Resuspend each cell pellet in 50 μL CyFACs.
Proceed to Fc-block and surface staining.
Add 5 μL undiluted Fc-block to each sample.
Incubate on ice for 10 min.
Distribute 50 μL of prepared surface antibody cocktail into appropriate wells according to the plate map.
Once the incubation is complete, distribute the totality of Fc-blocked samples into the appropriate wells containing the antibody cocktail.
Incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
During incubation, mix 1 part fix/perm concentrate (00-5123-43) with 3 parts fix/perm diluent (00-5223-56).
Prepare the eBioScienceTM Perm/Wash solution by diluting 2 mL of 10× Permeabilization Buffer stock into 18 mL of Ultra-Pure H2O.
Pellet cells by plate centrifugation at 400 g for 5 minutes.
Carefully aspirate supernatant (∼ 100 μL).
Wash once with 200 μL CyFACs.
Spin plate down at 400 g for 5 minutes.
Proceed to intracellular staining.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend samples thoroughly in 200 μL of FoxP3 Fixation/Permeabilization Buffer.
Incubate for 30 min at room temperature.
Prepare the intracellular antibody master mix in Perm/Wash.
Spin plate down (800 g, 5 min).
Wash once with 200 μL of Perm/Wash.
Aspirate and discard supernatant.
Resuspend sample in 50 μL of Perm/Wash.
Add 50 μL of intracellular master mix to each well containing the sample.
Incubate for 30 min at room temperature.
Add 100 μL of Perm/Wash to each well after incubation.
Spin plate down (800 g, 5 min).
Wash once with 200 μL of Perm/Wash.
Prepare fresh 4% PFA in Ultra-Pure H2O during spin.
Add 200 μL of fresh 4% PFA to each sample.
Spin down at 800 g for 10 min.
Proceed to DNA stain and Pre-Acquisition Wash.
Prepare the 191/193 DNA Intercalator at a 1:5000 dilution during spin.
Add 200 μL of 191/193 DNA Intercalator to each sample.
Incubate for 1 h at 4°C.
Pellet cells by plate centrifugation (800×g, 5 min).
Carefully aspirate and discard supernatant.
Resuspend the samples in 200 μL of MaxPar Cell Staining Buffer.
Transfer the sample into a labeled, polypropylene tube with a 35 μm cell pre-wetted strainer cap.
Add 300 μL of MaxPar Cell Staining Buffer per tube, bringing the total volume to 500 μL.
Spin the tubes down (800 g, 10 min).
Carefully aspirate and discard supernatant.
Resuspend the sample in 500 μL of MaxPar Cell Acquisition Solution (CAS).
Load 20 μL of sample directly into Cellometer® SD100 Cell Counting Chamber.
Spin the tube down (800 g, 5 min).
Count the cells using the Cellometer® Auto 2000 Cell Viability Counter during spin and record final cell count.
Prepare a 1:5 dilution of MaxPar EQ Calibration beads in CAS (CAS/EQ).
Vortex the EQ Calibration beads for 1 min before preparing CAS solution.
Carefully aspirate and discard supernatant.
Resuspend samples at a concentration of 1 x 10^6 cells per 1 mL of CAS/EQ solution.
Filter resuspended sample through a 35 μm cell pre-wetted strainer cap.
Proceed to mass cytometer acquisition.
